title_en: AutoScaffold: AI-Guided Scaffolding for Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
title_zh: AutoScaffold：AI引导的脚手架用于语言模型强化学习
summary_en: AutoScaffold is an AI-for-AI framework that converts a student model's training experience into adaptive scaffolds for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). A frozen teacher periodically examines the student's experience, diagnoses bottlenecks, and designs two types of scaffolds: shared strategies for task classes and hints for individual hard tasks, adjusting support as the student learns. Scaffolds are removed at evaluation. Applied to ALFWorld, search-based QA, mathematical reasoning, and GPU kernel generation, students trained with AutoScaffold outperform RL baselines without scaffolds, gaining 7.2 points in ALFWorld success, 4.0 points in average QA exact match, and up to 5.0 points in GPU kernel generation for tasks with correct kernels faster than PyTorch reference.
summary_zh: AutoScaffold 是一个 AI-for-AI 框架，可将学生模型的训练经验转化为自适应脚手架，用于带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）。一个冻结的教师模型定期检查学生经验、诊断瓶颈，并设计两种形式的脚手架：跨任务类别的共享策略和针对单个困难任务的提示，并根据学生学习进度调整支持内容和数量。评估时移除脚手架。在 ALFWorld、基于搜索的问答、数学推理和 GPU 内核生成四个领域应用后，无脚手架评估时，使用 AutoScaffold 训练的学生均优于相应 RL 基线：ALFWorld 成功率提升 7.2 分，问答平均精确匹配提升 4.0 分，GPU 内核生成中正确内核且运行快于 PyTorch 参考的任务比例最高提升 5.0 分。
content_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) produces rich training experience, yet outcome rewards reduce each attempt to a single number and leave most of this information unused. Training-time scaffolds, such as strategies or hints added to the prompt during training, offer a natural way to turn this information into guidance, but their design and adaptation are largely left to humans and tailored to specific domains. We introduce AutoScaffold, a unified AI-for-AI framework that turns a student's training experience into adaptive scaffolds, with minimal domain-specific information and no human intervention during training. A frozen teacher periodically examines this experience, diagnoses bottlenecks, and designs scaffolds in two forms: (i) strategies shared across a class of tasks and (ii) hints for individual hard tasks, adjusting the content and amount of support as the student learns. The scaffolds are removed at evaluation. We apply the same framework to ALFWorld, search-based QA, mathematical reasoning, and GPU kernel generation. When evaluated without scaffolds, students trained with AutoScaffold outperform those trained with the corresponding RL baselines in all four domains, with gains of 7.2 points in ALFWorld success and 4.0 points in average QA exact match.
